verdict.rationale: No evidence shows Stripe Treasury itself accepts natural-language commands, such as a built-in assistant or a chat or prompt interface in the Dashboard or API. The only related items are an official Stripe MCP server, an llms.txt file and a CLI. These belong to separate MCP, AI-docs and CLI stories, are Stripe-wide rather than Treasury-specific, and are building blocks for external agents rather than natural-language operation of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
